Menu FAQs Jump To Humanoids 101 Industrial Automation Pricing, RaaS, and roi Safety and standards Humanoids 101 How do commercial humanoid robots work with my existing management and execution systems, such as WMS, WES, MES, etc.? Show + Hide - Commercial humanoid robots are designed to act as an extension of your current software, rather than a separate, isolated tool. They connect to systems like your Warehouse Management System (WMS) or Manufacturing Execution System (MES) through a centralized, secure, cloud-based platform (like Agility’s Arc). This connection allows humanoids to receive real-time tasks and report back on their progress, ensuring that material movement stays in sync with your broader facility goals. By integrating this way, humanoid robots help bridge the gap between automated tools that typically don't talk to each other.
